objective: Beat QQQ on a CHF total-return basis with lower or comparable drawdown using ORACLE hybrid analyst logic.

rules.performance_measurement: Portfolio CHF total return versus synthetic QQQ CHF total return including USDCHF movement
rules.rebalance_trigger: Evidence-backed change in trend, causal proof, structural early-bird quality, entry attractiveness, fundamentals, invalidation, macro/geopolitical risk, or material relative-performance deterioration

notes: US market reference uses Sep 4 2026 close because Sep 7 2026 is a US market holiday.
This is a paper test only; no brokerage orders are placed.
